scope: Base-game source work with expansion/secondary records retained only under explicit applicability and authority boundaries
authorityBoundary: Licensed-digital and TTS structured sources are secondary. They corroborate, expose conflicts, identify source roles, and provide scoped keys; they never overwrite FAQ, rulebook, official help-sheet, or exact component wording.

gmnotesTaxonomy.boundary: GMNotes are source-local functional tags/state labels; numeric and expansion tags are not canonical rules vocabulary.

structuredCountBoundaries.handling: Keep all three counts scoped; do not equate Help entries or structured keys with physical tile copies.
Structured keys are not accepted as physical copy inventory.
Display/type variants and physical duplicates make counts non-isomorphic.
Structured unique wound types are distinct from physical card copies.
One structured table spans selected item families/types and cannot replace official deck/copy inventory.
Table combines Mission Tasks, standard Objectives, and Solo/Coop records; preserve scoped object keys and mode fields.

conflictInventory.duplicateDisplayNameBoundary: Display names are not keys. BGA table/object keys and scope remain the only source-local identifiers; duplicate names are retained in structuredIndex.tables[].duplicateDisplayNames.

extractionStatus: complete: one immutable BGA snapshot indexed; four copies proven identical; six TTS structured channels hashed, counted, and bounded as secondary provenance
